mapper.sql: CASE WHEN p.status = 'RISK_REVIEW' THEN '待风控复核' WHEN p.status = 'RISK_BLOCKED' THEN '风控拦截' WHEN p.status = 'RISK_REJECTED' THEN '风控拒绝' WHEN p.status = 'PAYING' THEN '支付中' WHEN p.status = 'FAIL' THEN '结果待确认' WHEN p.status = 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' WHEN p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND NOT () THEN '成功事实异常' WHEN p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND pr.cashier_status = '已完成' THEN '已完成' WHEN p.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN '支付成功' WHEN p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND pr.cashier_status IN ('待支付', '支付中', '已完成', '支付成功') THEN '支付中' WHEN p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND pr.cashier_status IN ('支付中', '已完成', '支付成功') AND pr.expires_at < NOW() THEN '已失效' WHEN p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND pr.cashier_status IN ('支付中', '已完成', '支付成功') THEN '待支付' WHEN pr.cashier_status IN ('已完成', '支付成功') THEN pr.cashier_status WHEN pr.expires_at < NOW() AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED') THEN '已失效' ELSE pr.cashier_status END

CASE WHEN p.status = 'RISK_REVIEW' THEN 'warn' WHEN p.status IN ('RISK_BLOCKED', 'RISK_REJECTED', 'FAIL', 'CLOSED') THEN 'danger' WHEN p.status = 'PAYING' THEN 'info' WHEN p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND NOT () THEN 'danger' WHEN p.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'success' WHEN p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND pr.cashier_status IN ('待支付', '支付中', '已完成', '支付成功') THEN 'info' WHEN p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND pr.cashier_status IN ('支付中', '已完成', '支付成功') AND pr.expires_at < NOW() THEN 'danger' WHEN p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND pr.cashier_status IN ('支付中', '已完成', '支付成功') THEN 'warn' WHEN pr.cashier_status IN ('已完成', '支付成功') THEN 'success' WHEN pr.expires_at < NOW() AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED') THEN 'danger' ELSE pr.cashier_status_type END

if.test: query.terminal != null and query.terminal != '' and query.terminal != '全部'
query.sessionStatus != null and query.sessionStatus != '' and query.sessionStatus != '全部'

mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN t_payment_order p ON p.payment_order_id = pr.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(pr.payment_order_id) AND CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256))

LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt latest_pa ON latest_pa.id = ( SELECT pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(pa.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) AND CAST(pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC, pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT pr.prepay_order_no AS sessionNo, pr.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, pr.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, pr.order_no AS orderNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, pr.bill_no AS billNo, pr.customer_name AS customerName, pr.cashier_title AS cashierTitle, pr.pay_scene AS payScene, COALESCE(latest_pa.terminal, pr.pay_scene) AS terminal, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(pr.amount, 2)) AS amount, AS sessionStatus, AS sessionStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(pr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(pr.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expiresAt FROM t_prepay_order pr
LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = pr.order_no AND CHAR_LENGTH(standard_order.order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(pr.order_no) AND CAST(standard_order.order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(pr.order_no AS BINARY(256)) AND pr.source_kind = 'STANDARD_ORDER' AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.source_kind) = CHAR_LENGTH('STANDARD_ORDER') AND CAST(pr.source_kind AS BINARY(16)) = CAST('STANDARD_ORDER' AS BINARY(16))
WHERE pr.prepay_order_no = #{sessionNo} AND CHAR_LENGTH(pr.prepay_order_no) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{sessionNo}) AND CAST(pr.prepay_order_no AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{sessionNo} AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1

SELECT pr.prepay_order_no AS sessionNo, pr.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, pr.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, pr.order_no AS orderNo, pr.bill_no AS billNo, pr.customer_name AS customerName, pr.cashier_title AS cashierTitle, pr.pay_scene AS payScene, COALESCE(latest_pa.terminal, pr.pay_scene) AS terminal, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(pr.amount, 2)) AS amount, AS sessionStatus, AS sessionStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(pr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(pr.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expiresAt FROM t_prepay_order pr
LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalSessionCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN () = '已失效' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expiredSessionCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN () IN ('支付成功', '已完成') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successSessionCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN () = '支付中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS payingSessionCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN () = '待支付' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingSessionCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN () NOT IN ('已失效', '支付成功', '已完成', '支付中', '待支付') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS otherSessionCount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(latest_pa.terminal, pr.pay_scene)) AS distinctTerminalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.expires_at > NOW() AND pr.expires_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, 15, NOW()) AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED') AND () NOT IN ('支付成功', '已完成', '已失效') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expiringSoonCount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(pr.amount), 0), 2)) AS totalAmount FROM t_prepay_order pr

SELECT pr.prepay_order_no AS sessionNo, pr.prepay_order_no AS prepayOrderNo, pr.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, pr.order_no AS orderNo, pr.bill_no AS billNo, pr.customer_name AS customerName, pr.cashier_title AS cashierTitle, pr.pay_scene AS payScene, COALESCE(latest_pa.terminal, pr.pay_scene) AS terminal, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(pr.amount, 2)) AS amount, AS sessionStatus, AS sessionStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(pr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(pr.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expiresAt FROM t_prepay_order pr
LIMIT 1001
